text: Things I'd tell myself before building my first app 🧵
Plan distribution before you write code.
"Build it and they'll come" is a lie.
Lead with the problem, not the product.
People relate to problems. Features come later.
Pick one tiny market and win it.
A few buildings beat a whole city.
Every rejection email is a free checklist.
Read it. Fix it. Resubmit. Don't take it personally.
Don't wait until you feel ready to share it.
Start posting while it's still messy.
Still learning all of this in real time.
